name: Saro's Easy Fly
statusMeaning: In the catalogue, not checked yet.
author: Sarocesch
description: Toggle creative-style flight with a simple /fly command, also for other players (e.g. /fly <playername>). No GUI, no config, works in any game mode.
evidence: Server-side mod: Kiln runs mods' code on Horizon's single-player server, not on dedicated servers. Everything its code calls is covered by Kiln development build 2026-11-14 (fa70eeb) (19 classes, 31 members). Not run yet.

softOff.why: only events, HUD, keys, commands and guarded mixin handlers
